'''Dao Stryver''' was a [[Gektl]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She enabled [[Lema Xandret]] to bring herself and her followers to [[Sebaddon]] and was thought to have disappeared into a black hole during the [[Independent Operation Sebaddon]], but later tracked down [[Jet Nebula]] in a cantina on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] after the operation's end. She later became a member of the [[Star Cabal]].

She was one of [[Mandalore the Vindicated|Mandalore's]] champions.

During the [[battle of Corellia]] while a meeting of the Star Cabal took place in the [[Star Chamber (space station)|Star Chamber]] space station, [[The Prince]] tried to appease [[Kolovish]] and [[Yem Leksende]] due to their loss on Corellia by stating that Stryver was already working with the Mandalorians.

{{Char-stub}}

==Equipment==
Along with grey and green Mandalorian armor made to fit her large frame, Stryver used a flame thrower mounted on her left wrist, a [[Jetpack/Legends|Jetpack]], a collapsible [[Shockstaff/Legends|shock stave]], a hand-held [[Disruptor pistol/Legends|Disruptor pistol]], a net launcher with interchangeable [[Razor net|razornets]] and [[Electroshock net|electronets]], [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]], a [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launcher]], a [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]] launcher, [[Stun Darts]] and a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].

==Behind the scenes==
Dao Stryver first appeared in the book ''Fatal Alliance'' by Sean Williams, and this is her only appearance to date. In the Dramatis Personae section, she is listed as a Mandalorian male, however in the epilogue of the book, Stryver is revealed to be a female Gektl.
